answer: Each agent posts a bond in escrow before it can bid, vote, or attest. Sybil attacks need many identities, so the bonds stack and the cost grows with every fake node. If a peer proves an agent cheated, its whole bond is forfeited, split between the challenger and the treasury. A river of honest bonds drowns out any fake crowd, because every false signal burns real collateral. Slashing ripples outward: anyone who vouched for the cheater loses part of their own bond too.
